question: Why is this level taught as above māyā in the scripture of paths?
premises: The scripture of paths classifies levels of reality.
Being devoid of instruments indicates transcendence of limitation.
Levels above māyā lack māyā-based instruments.
inference: Because it is devoid of instruments, it is taught in the scripture of paths as to be contemplated above māyā.
plain_english: And because it is devoid of instruments, it is taught in the scripture of the paths as something to be contemplated above māyā.
